integrity: Proof supplies exact mass quadrature, local-uniform limit, and global endpoint barriers. Companion checker performs numerical corroboration, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic one-dimensional cutoff reaction–diffusion equation; positive symmetric single-peaked pulses only; sharp asymptotic of competition-capacity maximum as cutoff tends to zero; does not prove finite-cutoff maximizing uniqueness, stability, stochastic persistence or multisoliton impossibility.
title: Sharp weak-cutoff carrying threshold for localized ecological trait distributions
